title: Sexual Assault Initial Response

steps.text: Ensure safety and medical care first
Contact the county Sexual Assault Response Team (SART/SANE)
Explain that a forensic exam is available even without reporting to police
Ask the victim, if possible, not to bathe, change, eat, drink or use the bathroom
Collect clothing in paper bags, not plastic
Secure the scene and note any electronic evidence (messages, video)
Brief initial interview only: what happened, suspect info, location, time
Leave the detailed interview to trained investigators
Notify the county prosecutor's sex crimes unit per county policy

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
